summary.text: Kim Coates is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 73, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Tangipahoa Parish. First elected in 2023, Kim Coates sits on the Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development, Appropriations, and Natural Resources and Environment committees.

paragraphs.text: The House page, which lists the member as Kimberly Landry Coates, gives the occupation as business marketing, with a B.A. from Southeastern Louisiana University.

The House page lists Kim Coates's committee assignments as Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development, Appropriations (elected member), Natural Resources and Environment, Joint Legislative Committee on the Budget, and House Select Committee on Women and Children, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus, Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, Louisiana Rural Caucus, and Northshore Delegation.
